name: Merchant Call hand-off reconciles Deal, Merchant, Business, CRM ID, and Deal Details
description:
Objective: Controlled Merchant Call hand-off dynamically reconciles every related UI surface with authoritative source data.
Preconditions: Authenticated QA user; exact approved APP-2026-000262 fixture already has the authorized one-shot Skip and Deal conversion; no replacement record may be created.
Steps:
1. Reconcile the application identity, persisted Skip timeline, and unique Deal association.
2. Click Go to Deals and verify /deals.
3. Search Deals by the application DBA, locate the row by Deal UUID, and validate all 20 meaningful columns from live source data.
4. Click the dynamically sourced Merchant name and validate identity, contact, identification, counts, documents, and portfolio metrics.
5. Return with browser Back and prove the same search and unchanged row cells.
6. Click the dynamically sourced Business name and validate identity, corporation, industry, address, ownership, and metrics.
7. Return with browser Back.
8. Click the dynamically sourced Deal ID.
9. Verify Deal Details, CRM ID interactivity, current Deal state, identities, and funding/payment terms.
10. Fail once at the end with every accumulated source-to-UI mismatch.
Expected: Every surface represents the same linked application, Deal, Merchant, and Business; all displayed fields match authoritative responses; unsupported data displays an explicit missing state rather than a fabricated default.
